title: Glossary · Faction Training Playbook
lede: The words and abbreviations you'll see all over Torn and this site. Each one links to the page that explains it properly.

groups.title: Your bars and stats
terms: Spent in the gym and on attacks. A full bar refills every 5 hours: 150 max as a donator, 100 otherwise.
Nerve is spent on crimes. NNB is your natural nerve bar: the maximum you earn from crime experience, before boosts.
Multiplies your gym gains. Your property sets the max. Anything above it resets at :00, :15, :30 and :45.
Stack energy and push happy far above max, then train it all inside one 15-minute window.
Strength, Speed, Defense and Dexterity. "Total stats" means all four added up.
Manual labor, Intelligence and Endurance. Jobs use them; courses and job training raise them.
A gym's multiplier for each stat. More dots, more gains per energy (George's is 7.3).
Torn City Time, the game clock. Happy resets and lease endings run on it.

groups.title: Items and boosters
terms: +250 energy and +75 happy. A drug with a 6–8 hour cooldown.
Ecstasy. Doubles your current happy; the cheapest big happy boost.
Erotic DVD. +2,500 happy (5,000 from a 10★ Adult Novelties). The main happy-jump booster.
Feathery Hotel Coupon. A booster that refills your energy bar.
A point refill: fills your energy bar once a day for 25 points.
Drug, booster and medical cooldowns are separate clocks. Using one does not touch the others.
Overdose. Empties your bars, puts you in hospital and can stretch your drug cooldown to a day.
Stat enhancer: an expensive item that adds stats directly. Worth it only at very high stats.

groups.title: Money and property
terms: Private Island, the best property. Rent one with an airstrip and hire a pilot for faster, bigger trips.
Donator status: a bigger energy bar and faster refill. A donator pack gives 31 days.
Item market: quick to sell on, with a 5% fee.
Your own shop. Buyers find it through tools like weav3r.
A trade left open with someone you trust, so your cash sits in it instead of your pocket.
Torn's second currency. Buys refills, merits, the stock ticker and more.
Enough shares of one stock to earn its payout or perk.
Trade a full set of flowers or plushies for points. Needs the History degree.
Getting paid to attack someone and lose. Short-term money only.

groups.title: Jobs, merits and education
terms: A company's rating from 0 to 10. More stars unlock more perks for employees.
Job points: one per company star per day, spent on company specials.
A company's perks, unlocked by its star rating.
Earned from awards (medals and honors), spent on permanent upgrades like Bank Interest.
Awards for milestones. Each one earns a merit.

groups.title: Fighting and factions
terms: Beat someone and take a cut of the cash they are carrying.
Hospital. "Medding out" means using medical items to leave early.
Pulling someone out of hospital. Useful in wars.
Getting someone out of jail by skill (bust) or by paying (bail).
Fair fight: bonus respect (up to ×3) for fighting someone near your stats. FF Scouter estimates it.
What faction attacks earn. Factions spend it on upgrades for every member.
A run of faction hits in a row. Respect per hit grows as the chain gets longer.
Retaliation: hitting someone who just attacked a faction member, for ×1.5 respect.
Ranked war between two factions. War hits earn double respect.
Organized crime, and your checkpoint pass rate in its role.
Crime experience and crime skill. They grow as you do crimes and raise your nerve and success.

groups.title: Tools
terms: Website for foreign stock, travel timing, chains and awards.
TornTools, a browser extension that adds information all over the game.
Torn PDA, the mobile app with script support.
